shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in package.json next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/CardStats.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx; do printf '\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:package.json && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git diff -- package.json'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Partial Prerender|pre-rendering shell|prerendering shell|static shell\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.md' | head -50"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"cacheComponents.*Suspense|Uncached data was accessed outside\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files .next/server/app | head -40 && rg -n -o 'Dashboard|Total Revenue|Total Invoices|Latest Invoices|Loading revenue chart|Loading dashboard' .next/server/app/index.html .next/server/app/index.rsc .next/server/app/page.html 2>/dev/null | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json next.config.ts && sed -n '1,200p' app/dashboard-data.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/page.tsx app/CardStats.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx && sed -n '1,120p' app/dashboard-data.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba app/dashboard-data.ts && nl -ba app/CardStats.tsx && nl -ba app/RevenueChart.tsx && nl -ba app/LatestInvoices.tsx'
